title: The Lancashire Creamery Strawberry Milkshake Deluxe 10ml E-Liquid
description: The Lancashire Creamery’s Strawberry Milkshake Deluxe delivers the taste of a rich, creamy milkshake infused with sweet, sun-ripened Strawberries. The inhale brings the bright, juicy flavour of fresh Strawberry, followed by the smooth, velvety milkshake base that adds a luscious creaminess to the profile. This indulgent blend offers a balanced dessert vape with a satisfyingly creamy exhale. This nic salt e-liquid delivers a smooth, comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The 50% VG / 50% PG ratio ensures a consistent flavour profile with discreet vapour production, perfect for pod systems, vape pens, and starter kits. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this 10ml e-liquid provides an option for vapers looking for a lower, moderate, or higher nicotine intake. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based brand known for crafting indulgent, dessert-inspired e-liquids, blending classic milkshake and bakery flavours to create deeply satisfying vape experiences.
